reviewer_role: Independent paper architect/reviewer delegated to a separate agent
review_scope: Actual completed three-seed S1-B scientific experiment and saved teacher-prefix diagnostics; no production replay or science rerun
confidence_scope: High for completed S1-B numerical/lineage integrity and descriptive training-prefix imitation improvement; no inference of DRL or generalization benefit
intended_claim: Progress toward large complex parent-scene DRL training followed by a frozen policy for fast complete constrained local task/trajectory planning; S1 is auxiliary initialization only
suggested_claim_revision: All three registered S1-B seeds completed exactly 256 batch-4 updates with finite numerical states and intact approved source/teacher/Adam/RNG lineage. On the same original 256 training teachers and all 8,292 saved prefix decisions per endpoint, masked route-macro CE decreased and state-micro top-1 teacher agreement increased for every seed. This demonstrates partial imitation on training teacher states and establishes the exact SL256 sources required for later S2; it does not establish route quality, unseen-scene generalization or a DRL contribution.
what_results_support: Actual completion of all three fixed supervised endpoints, 768/768 optimizer updates, rather than merely source preparation or loss-gradient smoke testing.
Teacher-forcing masked CE and action agreement improved on the full fixed teacher pool at paired untrained/SL256 endpoints for each seed.
Exact source revision and independent stage authorization, original S1-A teacher evidence, distinct initialization/data streams, Adam steps and committed journal/RNG cursors are coherent.
No numerical anomaly in saved weights/Adam states/gradients under the registered clipping tolerance; no new scene/navigation solve/teacher/native/H calls recorded for S1-B or diagnostics.
Complete immutable SL256 source bundles are available for the registered per-seed S2 forks.
what_results_dont_support: Complete mastery of teacher decisions: final top-1 agreement is only 38.56%-39.40%.
Autonomous route cost/quality, full-route coverage/feasibility/safety rates or deployment latency: predictions were scored but never executed.
Generalization to independent scenes/local scales or statistically significant superiority over native methods.
Any DRL benefit, S2 success or S3 success: these stages have not run and are not authorized by S1-B.
Real arm calibration, IK or physical joint-trajectory certification.
missing_evidence: Authorized S2 RL versus frozen-SL and matched continued-SL controls from the same per-seed SL256 sources, at fixed protocol endpoints and budgets.
Separately authorized later evaluation of complete frozen-policy local planning, cost/time/constraints and generalization under the frozen S3 rules.
Real physical calibration/IK evidence if claims are extended to physical robot/joint trajectories.
next_experiments_needed: After a new real S2 stage authorization binds the exact current protocol/source/registry/H and all three S1-B completion receipts, execute only the registered three-seed RL512+continuedSL512 plan; use matching own-seed SL256 weights and separate fresh Adam states.
Retain fixed512 endpoints and registered development checks; do not select a seed/checkpoint, enlarge budget or replace failed cases.
Obtain independent S3 authority before any sealed target-task performance evaluation; original60 remains sealed.
Do not add S1 retraining or unregistered post-hoc teacher/route tests to strengthen this stage result.

independent_verification.verification_procedure: Read-only independent Python commands in the review transcript; canonical SHA256 seed tuple reconstructed without importing the production RNG helper; raw torch.load tensor and Adam/RNG checks without policy/model/optimizer construction; all CSV route/state aggregates recomputed independently.
independent_verification.limitations: No second inference pass was run. The reviewer validated diagnostic source, saved endpoint identity, per-row coherence and all aggregates; original logits and complete per-state legal masks are not saved in CSV, so scores/mask membership were not independently regenerated.

timing.reading_reasoning_image_inspection_and_w: Not separately instrumented; do not infer active work duration from the interrupted review interval
timing.accounting_class: Read-only maintenance/review; no scientific training or planning

metric_interpretation.CE: Route-macro average: mean decision CE within each teacher route, then equal mean over 256 routes
metric_interpretation.top1: State-micro teacher-action agreement across 8,292 decisions; this weights longer routes more
metric_interpretation.pairing: All 256 original teachers and every saved prefix, exactly the same identities/actions/legal counts for each endpoint and seed
metric_interpretation.tie_break: Lowest local candidate index under exact logit equality
metric_interpretation.uniform_reference: Uniform expected agreement = 1/legal_count; not deterministic uniform-logit argmax
metric_interpretation.uncertainty: Only three fixed optimization seeds sharing one teacher pool. Descriptive across-seed SD is not independent-scene significance. Prefix states and routes can be correlated.
metric_interpretation.sampling: With-replacement training sampled 253/253/251 unique teachers; unsampled pool entries were not relabeled as independent validation.

figures.training_curve: All 256 raw updates per seed retained. Bold trace is trailing mean of up to 16 updates, not a confidence band. Gradient panel log-scale and threshold are labeled; line styles distinguish seeds.
figures.paired_teacher_plot: Fixed endpoints only, route-macro CE and state-micro top1 labeled separately. Top1 axis spans 0%-100%. Captions explicitly identify training teachers and teacher-forcing.
figures.fairness: Same teachers/prefixes at both endpoints; no best checkpoint, seed or teacher subset chosen. Untrained endpoint is the appropriate same-architecture reference for this stage.
figures.paper_use: Use at the intended full figure width. Adequate as descriptive auxiliary-initialization evidence; stronger method claims require later authorized controls.

resource_review.clock_limitations: Production and diagnostic receipts are measured internal intervals. Imports/process startup before main and the final tiny receipt/hash/write closure are not independently instrumented exact outer-process durations. Nested clocks must not be summed; the shared diagnostic is counted once for actual total and wholly assigned to each seed only for conservative cap checking.
